policies.name: Critical Mirai Botnet Activity
policies.description: Immediately flag Mirai greeth/greip/udpplain botnet traffic as CRITICAL.

policies.name: High Volume DDoS Flood
policies.description: Elevate confirmed distributed denial of service attack floods to HIGH severity.

policies.name: Web & Command Injection Exploit
policies.description: Flag SQLi, XSS, and remote command injection IoT attacks as HIGH severity.

policies.name: Reconnaissance & Port Scanning
policies.description: Flag port sweeps, host discovery, and vulnerability scans as MEDIUM severity.

policies.name: Denial of Service (DoS)
policies.description: Flag single-source DoS flooding as MEDIUM severity.

policies.name: Spoofing & Man-In-The-Middle
policies.description: Flag ARP spoofing and DNS cache poisoning as MEDIUM severity.

policies.name: Brute Force Password Guessing
policies.description: Flag dictionary and brute force attempts on IoT credentials as LOW severity.
